question:
For each $n\ge1$, let $a_n$ and $b_n$ be real numbers such that $a_n\ne0$ and $b_n\ne0$. Let
\[
(a_n+i b_n)^n=n(a_n+i b_n)\qquad\text{for all }n\ge6.
\]
Then
solution:
Since $a_n+i b_n\ne0$,
\[
(a_n+i b_n)^{n-1}=n.
\]
Thus the nonzero $(n-1)$st roots of $n$ give
\[
a_n+i b_n=n^{1/(n-1)}\left(\cos\frac{2\pi k}{n-1}+i\sin\frac{2\pi k}{n-1}\right),
\]
with $0\le k<n-1$. Hence option (D) is valid.
